about: Real machine footage published by others under reusable licences (CC BY 3.0, CC0, public domain). Re-encoded excerpts; credit and source for each clip below. See data/VIDEO_SOURCES.md.

clips.title: Motor-pump skid · walk-around
clips.note: A hand-held walk around a real motor and pump on a skid. The camera moves, so Spark re-reads each shot and SAM 3.1 tracks the parts through it.
clips.what: Exposed motor and centrifugal pump on a skid with a vibration analyser; hand-held camera moves around the machine

clips.title: Transmission belt drive
clips.note: A belt drive running in a fixed shot. The sensor goes on the fixed beam, never on the moving belt.
clips.what: Industrial transmission belt running, static shot with the machine's own sound

clips.title: Mine conveyor drive motors
clips.note: Drive motors of a conveyor in the Velenje coal mine, with the sound of the machines underground.
clips.what: Drive motors for a conveyor underground in the Velenje Coal Mine

clips.title: Factory exhaust fan · run-up
clips.note: Run-up from standstill: the mic tachometer follows the blade-pass tone; SAM places sensors on the casing and frame.
clips.what: 84-inch (2.13 m) direct-drive exhaust fan in a factory starting from standstill to full speed; steady shot for ~0-22 s
clips.credit: Agro Air Dynamics (a division of Agromatic Inc)

clips.title: AC condenser fan · coast-down
clips.note: Switched off mid-clip: a natural coast-down sweep for order tracking and resonance.
clips.what: Carrier outdoor AC condenser unit fan running, then switched off and coasting to a stop (vertical phone video, pillarbox cropped)

clips.title: Rotordynamics rig · UNESP
clips.note: University test rig (motor, slender shaft, disk). Handheld with narration: watch the capture coach react.
clips.what: University rotordynamics test rig (WEG motor + VFD, slender shaft, disk with reflective markers, bearing pedestals); static camera, rotor spinning then slowing at the end

clips.title: Rotor disk close-up · UNESP
clips.note: Disk with 16 markers on a slender shaft: shaft whirl and optical speed.
clips.what: Close-up of the same rotor rig: disk with 16 white markers on a slender shaft, rotating; slow camera dolly then steady

clips.title: Induction motor on a load-test bench
clips.note: Large motor coupled to a dynamometer: steady tonal operation.
clips.what: Large red induction motor coupled to a blue dynamometer on a load-test bench in a motor repair shop, running

clips.title: Submersible pump sucking air
clips.note: Abnormal pump operation: periodic air slurp bursts in the audio (cavitation-like signature).
clips.what: Small submersible drainage pump in a pit 'slurping' (sucking air at low water level); static camera

clips.title: Gear pump · visible cavitation
clips.note: Cavitation bubbles seen through a window (no audio).
clips.what: Gear pump with a transparent window showing cavitation bubbles forming in hydraulic oil on the suction side; static camera, 50 fps

clips.title: Electromagnetic vibration demo
clips.note: A rotating magnet excites a steel structure: forced vibration and noise.
clips.what: Lab demo: a rotating permanent magnet excites a steel structure, producing electromagnetic noise and vibration

clips.title: Wind turbine · static shot
clips.note: Rotor seen from the ground: blade-pass from video.
clips.what: Horizontal-axis wind turbine rotating against blue sky, static wide shot

clips.title: Tacoma Narrows Bridge · 1940
clips.note: The most famous resonance on film: torsional mode of a suspension bridge (public domain).
clips.what: Tacoma Narrows Bridge torsional oscillation and collapse, 7 Nov 1940 (archival B/W film)

clips.title: Diesel genset 1500 kVA · step load
clips.note: Container genset during a 0-50 % step-load test. Every audio line is a multiple of 12.49 Hz: a 750 rpm machine or a 1500 rpm four-stroke's half orders. The kinematic posterior and the 49.94 Hz generator line decide it.
clips.what: 1500 kVA backup diesel generator in a container (NXDATA), tested with a 0-50 % step load; static wide shot

clips.title: Diesel genset · controller reads 1542 rpm
clips.note: The PowerCommand display shows 51.3 Hz / 1542 rpm. Muse Spark reads it; the microphone posterior is computed without it and checked against it.
clips.what: Cummins diesel generating set: controller display (Hz, rpm) then the running engine bay; handheld

clips.title: Washing machine · 1400 rpm final spin
clips.note: Front loader in a very unbalanced final spin, handheld. The drum-order comb sits at 23.06 Hz.
clips.what: Front-loading washing machine (black) running an unbalanced 1400 rpm final spin; handheld phone video

clips.title: Washing machine · unbalanced spin (drum)
clips.note: Static close-up of a front-loader drum during an unbalanced spin: load distribution and drum motion.
clips.what: Front-loading washer drum viewed through the door during an unbalanced spin cycle; static camera

clips.title: Self-priming centrifugal pump · bench
clips.note: Small self-priming pump on a table discharging into a bucket; motor and casing in view, mains at 50 Hz.
clips.what: Small self-priming centrifugal pump on a table discharging water into a bucket; mostly static camera
